messages:
jordan: CrescentHealth dropped an RFI. They want a capability matrix, POC ops plan, deployment options note (hosted/dedicated/private), and a ballpark for a 3-month POC: 90M tokens/month + 12k embeddings. 48h SLA from them. Who can own parts?

nora: Ill take the capability matrix. Procurement asked for explicit rows: quantization profiles, adaptive batching, KV cache, model fallback, and SSO/KMS.

sam: I can do a pricing estimate. Rough hosted 3-month ballpark depending on model/caching: $22k-$30k. Small dedicated reserved pool ~ $38k/mo commit or $22k/mo w/ burst credits. Will confirm with Finance.

eli: Ill draft the security answers: KMS BYOK, optional HSM for Private, SOC/ISO attachments. Also confirm audit log streaming to customer storage for Dedicated/Private.

jordan: Please also clarify whether we deliver model weights (they asked) and if the POC can run in their Azure subscription.

nora: Short answers: we dont hand over Redwood-managed performance weights. Open-catalog models can be deployed per license.

eli: POC in customer Azure: Hosted = no. Dedicated = possible with peered VNet + reserved nodes; Private = yes (VNet or on-prem). Adding a table in the RFI doc.

nora: Adding a row: "Automated fallback to compatible model variants (same API)" and separate rows for 8-bit/4-bit quant profiles.

sam: Pricing file uploaded: https://drive.internal/sales/crescenthealth/pricing-draft.csv - finance pinged for a POC discount approval.

buildbot: (uploaded) crescent_rfi_assets_v1.zip - capability_matrix.xlsx, rfi_answers.md, poc_ops_runbook.md, pricing_estimate.csv

jordan: Ops runbook snippet to include:
``n
route: crescent-poc
model: redwood-7b-quant
batching: adaptive
canary: {pct:5, window:24h}
rollback: latency>2s || errors>1%
``n
eli: Also include explicit line: "Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and optional HSM integration; audit logs can be exported to customer storage with IAM policies."

nora: Perf one-pager for 2k context + 512 gen will be attached (redwood-7b-quant and redwood-13b-8bit).

sam: Once finance confirms discount Ill update pricing_estimate.csv and stamp approved. Target to send bundle by 09:00 PDT tomorrow.

buildbot: (uploaded) crescent_rfi_final_v1.zip - capability_matrix.pdf, rfi_responses.md, poc_plan.pdf, pricing_final.csv, perf_summary.pdf

jordan: Sent to CrescentHealth procurement 2025-01-18T16:02:10Z with note: "Attached RFI bundle and POC plan. Happy to schedule a walkthrough/technical review."

eli: Crescent replied: "Can you confirm Dedicated POC SLA and whether audit logs can be sent to our Azure Blob? Also need a named contact for security review."

eli: Replied: Dedicated POC SLA varies by region; we can offer 99.9% for reserved pools during the POC. Audit logs: yes, can stream to Azure Blob with SAS/IAM. Security contacts: eli and nora.

jordan: Marking resolved after Finance approval and Legal sign-off on RFI text. Following up in AM. :thumbsup:
